hardware.snapshot_limitation: Instantaneous total device values outside failed inference, not per-model allocation or proof of OOM/idle during timeout.

owned_synthetic_prompt_reconstruction.limits: Reconstructed only from accepted correction, original question and current worker template. No raw text copied. Chat template/tokenization/actual wire not captured.

minimum: Record bounded request-body byte lengths and selected inference-policy presence/version without text.
Split coarse model_request into bounded connection/response-header/body-read/parse timings; retain strict allowlists and old-receipt compatibility.

If supported by the exact server build, capture provider-reported prompt/output/reasoning counts, TTFT, final stop reason and MTP accepted/rejected counters for the same owned synthetic call. Missing values remain UNKNOWN.
Distinguish queue/prefill/decode/read from a socket timeout before proposing performance changes.

authorization_boundary: No automatic profile change, higher token/context/timeout budget, reasoning override, provider fallback, draft configuration or GPU resource redistribution.
Any profile/resource experiment must be separately bounded, preserve current baseline, avoid shared-service changes without explicit authorization, and compare equivalent inputs/output conditions.
